Card Q&A.q: Does the Digimon that has this card as it's digivolution card count itself for this card's inherited effect?

Card Q&A.a: No, it doesn't. If you have 2 or more Digimon, this effect can only get that Digimon +1000 DP.
Card Q&A.q: If I have 4 Digimon, does a Digimon with this card in its digivolution cards get +2000 DP with this card's inherited effect?

Inherited Effect: [Your Turn] While you have 2 or more Digimon in play, this Digimon gets +1000 DP.
